user_question: Summarize mean elevation for the census tracts that intersect State College borough.

outputs.summary: No authorized recovery succeeded: The worker reported success, but the produced artifact is a CSV weather table rather than the required State College borough boundary dataset in GPKG format. The evidence does not establish a polygon boundary or satisfy the task's expected output.

workflow_plan.goal: Summarize mean elevation for the census tracts that intersect State College borough.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve State College borough boundary
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain a polygon boundary for State College borough to identify intersecting census tracts.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve the available dataset representing the State College borough boundary. Return the highest-ranked suitable catalog candidate and its metadata.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject borough boundary to tract CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Make the retrieved borough boundary compatible with the census tract layer for intersection.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the retrieved State College borough boundary to EPSG:26918. Do not guess the source CRS; proceed only when the source CRS is present and known.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject elevation raster to tract CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Align the elevation raster with the census tract zones for zonal statistics.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the elevation GeoTIFF from its known CRS to EPSG:26918 while preserving the elevation values.

workflow_steps.title: Identify census tracts intersecting State College borough
workflow_steps.purpose: Create the polygon zones consisting of census tracts that intersect the State College borough boundary.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform an intersection overlay between the census tract polygons and the State College borough boundary. Preserve the tract identifiers and return the census tract features that intersect the borough.

workflow_steps.title: Summarize mean elevation by intersecting tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Compute mean elevation for each census tract zone intersecting State College borough.
workflow_steps.instructions: Compute zonal statistics on the elevation raster using the intersecting census tract zones. Produce a CSV summary containing the mean elevation for each tract and retain the tract identifiers.

requirements.scope: Retrieved State College borough boundary must have a known source CRS before reprojection.
Census tract polygons and State College borough boundary must use compatible CRSs for intersection overlay.
Elevation raster and intersecting tract zones must use matching CRSs for zonal statistics.
